script.title: How a planet can throw a spacecraft across the solar system
script.description: Watch how a spacecraft uses a planet's orbital motion to gain speed without using any fuel.

shots.narration: A small spacecraft travels through the deep cold of space toward a massive world. The planet is not sitting still, but moves quickly along its own wide orbit.
As the craft nears the planet, gravity takes hold. The massive world pulls on the smaller object, curving its straight path into a long, sweeping arc.
Because the planet is moving, it drags the probe along with it. The craft steals a tiny bit of the planet's motion and leaves much faster than it arrived.
